stages.title: Revoke the source-backed installed claim
notes: The wave-20 ee review/refusal installed PASS is revoked to a source layer because it invoked the checkout CLI/demo over ee data; the historical report and runs stay untouched. The gate now fails an installed claim whose consumer is not the package.

stages.title: Consumer and data provenance are separate
notes: personalReview/refusals record consumerEntry with the package source/build/tar and the actual start/daemon/prepare/demo file hashes. A full positive report passes; a foreign consumer package or a source origin is rejected with a focused consumer_entry code even when the data tuple matches.

stages.title: Accurate new target
notes: All cases, the helper and the upgrade pair move to e4e0623/build637ed44e850f447a; ee is the safety baseline and 97 the mock control. Ordinary ee scopes stay history and are not relabelled.

stages.title: Package read selection is effective
notes: The review file is produced by package-internal restored-review code and startup uses package bin/pa: unbound 403, explicit file yields candidates/history/sources/original body 200, business 422, held queue unchanged, provider requests unchanged. No checkout CLI/demo is used for this installed claim.

stages.title: Reuse consistency
notes: Same valid file reuses the live PID; different/missing file, port change and an unbound daemon followed by a selection must not silently reuse, and refusals must not change the PID. Actual health identity is recorded; this package predates the f856 digest, so digest identity is scoped NOT_REACHED. The measured silent different-selection reuse is a real D gap and fails the required case rather than being waived.

stages.title: Both formats over the same data
notes: The package format case creates and verifies default v1 (13 families) and explicit v2 (21 families, version 3 refused, source DB unchanged) from the restored store; personal review reads the restored data. personal-evidence/backup protocols remain separate.

stages.title: Source/read/startup layers
notes: Source prepare/confirm/audit and the original token remain facts; the review file is read-only historical consent with a five-minute startup window, not a private startup grant, target authorization or execution reuse. Backup/credentials do not inherit.

stages.title: Upgrade and faults
notes: ee→e4e same schema18, 16→18, three fault windows with status/exit/pointer/operation/data, tamper refusal and rollback keeping post-upgrade data.

stages.title: Bounded user validation
notes: Concurrent readonly reads, repeated confirmations and a service reopen return queue/counts/provider to baseline; desktop/mobile surfaces stay scoped to the known workbench.

stages.title: Final same-consumer verdict
notes: wave21-status records the e4e data subject and consumer entry hashes separately, the personal review/reuse results, and the source-only historical scope. Required set is not relaxed; the reuse failure blocks installed-alpha for this package until D ships the selection-identity fix.
